answers.why: Amaziah gathers Judah and organizes its men into military units.
All Judah supplies men aged twenty and above for Amaziah's army.
Benjamin supplies soldiers alongside Judah in the military census.
Amaziah hires one hundred thousand warriors from Israel.
Israel names the people whose army is forbidden to accompany Amaziah.
Israel is explicitly identified with all the children of Ephraim.
Israel names the nation whose hired army received the hundred talents.
The dismissed army came from Ephraim and returns to its own homes.
The dismissed soldiers become angry with Judah after Amaziah sends them home.
Joash warns that Amaziah and his kingdom Judah will fall together.
Judah suffers military defeat and its men flee to their tents.
Israel is the opposing nation before which Judah is defeated.
Ephraim identifies Jerusalem's gate toward the tribal territory.
Israel is paired with Judah as a kingdom whose kings have recorded histories.
